abi_freeze.note: Nothing here freezes the host ABI. Operation tags, value/result schemas, image version/loading rules, resource/failure semantics, effects, the authorized import set, deterministic arithmetic/collection behavior, and portable-vs-platform behavior freeze at RW-070 with independent boundary fixtures. This record only reserves the mechanism (versioned host-ABI imports under a positive import manifest).

carveout_10_2_6.note: Cryptographic primitives and optional bounded solver engines may remain explicit bounded native dependencies with exact imports/owners/versions/semantics/limits/tests at RW-070. They never receive language-owned discharge judgment: no imported discharge service decides promotion; the Sley semantic implementation of approved deterministic discharge profiles owns the judgment. Hand-rolling cryptography in Sley to reduce a dependency count is prohibited.

charter: RW-030 MPI-0 controls and self-hosting/host-boundary charter (2026-09-06). Depends on RW-020 COMPLETE. distinctions_10_4.compiler_service_ban: No listed Sley-owned responsibility may delegate its judgment to an imported compile, typecheck, lower, validate_program, or discharge service. RW-070 ships tests denying compiler-service imports.
distinctions_10_4.giant_opcode_ban: No native primitive may validate SSMC, resolve types, compute Witness trust, choose mandatory tests, or emit the compiler image. A primitive doing so invalidates SH2.
distinctions_10_4.verifier_vs_checker: A native bytecode verifier may reject malformed execution images for memory safety only. It must not replace language-level checking; language-level verdicts bind the approved toolchain image, receipt, candidate, base root, policy, epoch, and evidence (never a caller-supplied VALID field).
